page.title: Case workspace
page.purpose: Open a sourced case, understand the current evidence graph, and keep gaps visible before creating a local packet.

states.description: The case workspace shows the selected case, evidence graph, and source inspector.
The case or a bounded public source read is loading; the last stable graph remains labelled.
No cases have been opened; the bundled, cited public example is offered for offline review.
Some history or a provider result is unavailable; each absent interval is shown as a gap.
The graph uses a prior capture and displays its retrieval time and source hash.
A source request failed; the operator can retry or inspect a cached capture.
